title: VETIAS Institution Profile & Accreditation
content: VET Institute of Arts & Science (VETIAS) is a co-educational autonomous-track institution located in Erode, Tamil Nadu, affiliated with Bharathiar University, Coimbatore. Established under the Vellalar Educational Trust, VETIAS specializes in AI, Data Science, Computing, Commerce, and Global Management.

title: Campus Location & Admissions Contact
content: VETIAS campus is situated at Thindal, Erode - 638012, Tamil Nadu. For unverified or bespoke admission queries, applicants can contact the Admissions Office at admissions@vetias.edu.in or call +91-4294-224400 (Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM IST).

title: B.Sc Computer Science (AI & Data Science) Overview
content: Course Code VET-AIDS-01: B.Sc Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence & Data Science) is a 3-year UG program with 60 seats intake. Tuition fee is ₹38,000 per semester. Curriculum covers Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Big Data, and Generative AI.

title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) Overview
content: Course Code VET-BCA-02: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) is a 3-year UG program with 120 seats intake. Tuition fee is ₹32,000 per semester. Focuses on full-stack web engineering, Java, mobile app development, DBMS, and cloud fundamentals.

title: B.Sc Computer Science Overview
content: Course Code VET-CS-03: B.Sc Computer Science is a 3-year UG program with 60 seats intake. Tuition fee is ₹30,000 per semester. Covers operating systems, data structures, algorithms, compiler design, computer networks, and cloud infrastructure.

title: B.Com (Professional Accounting) Overview
content: Course Code VET-BCOM-04: B.Com (Professional Accounting) is a 3-year UG program with 60 seats intake. Tuition fee is ₹34,000 per semester. Features integrated CA Foundation and CMA coaching alongside IFRS, corporate taxation, and auditing.

title: B.Com (Computer Applications) Overview
content: Course Code VET-BCOM-05: B.Com (Computer Applications) is a 3-year UG program with 60 seats intake. Tuition fee is ₹28,000 per semester. Blends commercial accounting, Tally/ERP enterprise software, e-commerce, and business analytics.

title: BBA (International Business) Overview
content: Course Code VET-BBA-06: BBA (International Business) is a 3-year UG management program with 60 seats intake. Tuition fee is ₹32,000 per semester. Covers global supply chains, international trade law, EXIM operations, and cross-border strategy.

title: M.Sc Data Analytics Postgraduate Program
content: Course Code VET-MSC-07: M.Sc Data Analytics is a 2-year PG program with 30 seats intake. Tuition fee is ₹42,000 per semester. Covers advanced statistical modeling, time-series forecasting, deep predictive analytics, MLOps, and cloud data pipelines.

title: Diploma in Applied AI & Cloud Computing
content: Course Code VET-DIP-08: Diploma in Applied AI & Cloud Computing is a 1-year career-oriented diploma with 40 seats intake. Tuition fee is ₹22,000 per semester. Eligibility: 10+2 pass or equivalent.

title: UG & PG Admission Eligibility Criteria
content: For UG programs, candidates must have passed 10+2 (Higher Secondary) from Tamil Nadu State Board, CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent. B.Sc AI & DS requires at least 55% with Mathematics/Computer Science; BCA, B.Sc CS, B.Com CA, and BBA require 50%; M.Sc Data Analytics requires a relevant Bachelor degree with 55%.

title: Online Admission Procedure (2026-2027 Session)
content: Admissions for Academic Session 2026-2027 Phase 2 are open. Step 1: Submit the Online Admission Application with Personal, 10th/12th Academic, and Course choices. Step 2: Receive a unique reference number (VETIAS-2026-APP-XXXX). Step 3: Attend counseling and original certificate verification on campus.

title: Required Documents for Admission Verification
content: Shortlisted applicants must present: 10th and 12th standard original marksheets, Transfer Certificate (TC), Community Certificate (if applicable), First Graduate Certificate signed by Revenue Officer (if claiming First Graduate quota), Aadhaar Card copy, and 4 passport-size photographs.

title: Application Tracking & Counseling Rounds
content: Applicants can track real-time application status using their reference number (e.g. VETIAS-2026-APP-XXXX) and registered email or mobile number. Status stages include Submitted, Under Review, Shortlisted for Round 1/2 Counseling, and Admission Confirmed.

title: Merit & First Graduate Scholarships
content: VETIAS offers Merit Scholarships (up to 50% tuition waiver for 90%+ in +2 board exams, 25% waiver for 85-89.9%), First Graduate Scholarships (20% tuition concession with valid Revenue Officer certificate), Sports Excellence Scholarships, and Government SC/ST/BC/MBC scholarship assistance.

title: Scholarship Deadlines & Fee Payment Policy
content: First Graduate and Merit Scholarship certificates for the 2026-2027 intake must be uploaded or submitted before November 15, 2026. Semester tuition fees cover lab access, library membership, and university exam registration.

title: Boys & Girls Hostel Accommodation & Mess Fees
content: Separate, secure on-campus residential hostels are available for boys and girls with 24/7 CCTV security, Wi-Fi, study halls, and medical support. Hostel accommodation plus nutritious vegetarian/non-vegetarian mess fee is ₹45,000 per academic year (twin-sharing) or ₹54,000 (single/AC wing where available).

title: Laboratories, Library & Campus Transport
content: Campus facilities include dedicated NVIDIA GPU AI & Data Science Labs, 350+ workstation coding centers, a central digital library with 42,000+ volumes and IEEE/Springer access, Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Auditorium, indoor sports complex, and 28 GPS-enabled college buses covering Erode, Salem, Tiruppur, and Namakkal.

title: Placement Record & Top Recruiters
content: VETIAS maintains a 94% placement success rate for eligible graduating students. Top recruiters include Zoho, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, HCLTech, Deloitte, EY, Accenture, and Freshworks. Highest package offered reached ₹12.5 LPA with an average package of ₹4.8 LPA.

title: Placement Training & Career Readiness Cell
content: The Central Placement & Training Block runs mandatory aptitude, Data Structures & Algorithms, mock technical interviews, and communication workshops starting from Semester 3, alongside industry internships in Semester 5 and 6.

title: CYBERTRON 2026 — National AI Symposium
content: CYBERTRON 2026 is the National AI Symposium and 24-hour Hackathon hosted by the Department of AI & DS on November 12, 2026 at Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Auditorium. Features keynote sessions on Generative AI, project expo, and ₹1,50,000 prize pool.

title: Annual Mega Campus Placement Drive 2026
content: The Annual Mega Campus Placement Drive 2026 takes place December 05–08, 2026 at the Central Placement & Training Block, bringing 45+ technology, analytics, and finance recruiters for final-year UG and PG cohorts.

title: 12th Stream Guidance & Program Matching
content: Students from 12th Computer Science or Pure Mathematics streams excel in B.Sc CS (AI & DS), BCA, and B.Sc Computer Science. Commerce-Accountancy students are ideal for B.Com (Professional Accounting), B.Com (Computer Applications), and BBA (International Business). Maths-Biology students with strong analytical aptitude are eligible for BCA and BBA.
